 HMD has launched the Nokia 2360 Flip in the Philippines.  
 The Nokia 2360 Flip features a 2.8-inch internal display and a 1.77-inch external screen. Other specifications include a removable 1,450mAh battery, QVGA camera and a 3.5mm headphone jack. There is also FM radio, loudspeaker and 4MB of internal storage.
 One of its key features is Family Assist. It lets designated family members remotely manage contacts, adjust volume and set daily reminders. It also has a dedicated SOS button that automatically calls a primary emergency contact and sends alerts to up to five pre-set numbers.
 However, the phone only supports 2G connectivity. The clamshell feature phone is designed for users who prefer simpler communication. It is aimed specifically for senior citizens and school students.
 The Nokia 2360 Flip is available in Nokia’s official Shopee store Shopee → for PHP 2,790. It is available in burgundy and grey.
